audit.whatIsWrong: packet flags the exact defect: content win[0..5]=Varus, but every full-layer phases[0..5].side read the placeholder 'Skill' with owner-positive why text describing Seraphine winning.
audit.why: The level chart and the prose under it disagreed for six straight rows.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..5].side to Varus and rewrote each why to state the actual reason he wins that stage (charge-poke range, W stacks, R engage, item burst). phases[6]/win[6] already both read 'Skill' and were left alone.

audit.why: Varus out-ranges and out-pokes Seraphine from level 1 through his charged Q and W stacks, spikes hardest at 6 (point-and-click Chain of Corruption) and at first item (W detonation burst); the matchup only evens once Seraphine's range and Encore catch up late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); Hail of Arrows applying Grievous Wounds to Seraphine's own sustain, and Blighted Quiver's max-health magic damage bypassing armor, weren't stated (missingInteractions).
audit.why: Chain of Corruption is 100s early/60s maxed, Hail of Arrows also carries Grievous Wounds so trades need to land before it applies, and W detonation scales off max HP so stacking armor is the wrong itemization answer.
audit.corrected: Added real numbers plus the Grievous Wounds timing to breakdown.cooldowns, and the HP-scaling point to breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions also listed a 'needs-antiheal' rule claiming Varus sustains through Hail of Arrows (E), but the kit text says E reduces enemies' self-healing/regen — it does not heal Varus.
audit.why: The rule appears to have the direction backwards; applying it as written would ship a false claim about Varus healing off his E.
audit.corrected: Did not add a 'Varus sustains via E' claim. Instead used the correct direction of that same interaction (his E applies Grievous Wounds to Seraphine) in breakdown.cooldowns.
